title: Security Engineer
description: Who we are? It’s time to turn on bright mode. Let’s meet! We are a software company that produces niche technologies with an innovative, dynamic, and added-value understanding to the leading companies in its field, serving in different sectors in Turkey and abroad. For starters, the first thing you should know is that Crs is an umbrella organization. Our e-transformation brand, e-dünya, offers digital solutions on a single platform. Our game brand Corvus Jay provides players of all ages and backgrounds with captivating, humorous, and artistic games that transcend the ordinary and deliver unforgettable experiences with its open-minded, humorous, creative, and vibrant world of pop art. We are excited to expand our investment areas and the sectors we are involved in. Our focus is on innovative research, exploring Big Data Processing, AI, machine learning, and game development. As one of the top 500 IT companies in Turkey, we are one of the fastest-growing technology companies selected by Deloitte Turkey for the 6th time in a row. Our route is always the same, the future! Job Description As a Security Engineer, you will be our internal "ethical hacker." Your mission is to find vulnerabilities before the bad guys do and help us build bulletproof technologies. Experience & Skills BS degree in Computer Engineering, Cyber Security, or a related field. Experience in Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Management. Expertise with offensive security tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Nmap, Nessus, SQLmap, and Kali Linux. Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10 and SANS Top 25 vulnerabilities. Hands-on experience with network security (Firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF, VPNs). Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to develop custom exploits or automation scripts. Familiarity with Cloud Security (Azure/AWS) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes) from an offensive perspective. Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, eJPT, or GPEN) are a huge plus. Strong analytical thinking and a "hacker mindset" — the ability to think outside the box. Good command of English to follow global security trends and documentation. Responsibilities: Execute end-to-end penetration tests on web applications, mobile apps (iOS/Android), and network infrastructure. Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and security scans using both automated tools and manual techniques. Review source code (SAST/DAST) to identify security flaws in early development stages (C#, JavaScript, etc.). Develop and implement exploit proofs to demonstrate the impact of discovered vulnerabilities. Evaluate detection capabilities by validating security alerts through simulated attack scenarios. Collaborate with developers to provide clear, actionable remediation guidance and verify fixes. Automate security testing by integrating tools into our CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps). Stay ahead of the curve by researching the latest threats, zero-day vulnerabilities, and bypass techniques. Draft detailed technical reports for both technical teams and management, outlining risks and mitigation strategies. Perks & Benefits Buffet breakfast in the office every morning Comprehensive private health insurance package Meal card & commute compensation, Lots of events and celebrations (check out @crssoft on Instagram) Education fund to support learning and development opportunities Paid birthday off to spend time with your loved ones A gift book on your birthday All the technical equipment and licenses you need Interviews and Q&A sessions with experts Marriage leave (5 days) No dress code! Join Us Work hard play hard.😊 At Crs Soft, we benefit from the power of technology and science, and we achieve the best with our creative and innovative team. Lifelong learning, open-mindedness and leadership are part of our culture. We celebrate all our achievements and special moments together, and we know how to have fun.

title: Software Development Engineer – Industrial Networks and Security
description: We are the catalyst for the industrial world’s digital transformation. For more than 35 years, groundbreaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey. We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers. We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries. What are your responsibilities? Design and implement firmware features for industrial routers and security devices Develop networking functionality including routing, VPNs, firewalls, VLANs, and remote-access solutions Contribute to secure connectivity solutions supporting industrial automation and critical infrastructure Drive feature development from concept to customer deployment What do you need to qualify for this job? BSc., MSc. Or PhD in Computer Science, Electronics, Control Engineering or related areas Proven 3+ years of experience in software development Strong programming skills in C/C++ Experience with Embedded Linux development / Linux Kernel Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking Experience in VPN technologies (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard) Experience in firewalls and cybersecurity products Experience using Git-based development workflows Ability to analyze and solve system-level software issues Experience in Docker and Container technologies Experience in development of industrial communication network protocols, tools, and libraries (Switching & Routing Protocols, Netlink, Netfilter, Iproute2, CONFD, NETCONF, SNMP, etc.) Experience in CI/CD and DevOps pipelines Experience in Azure DevOps or similar platforms Strong communication skills in an international engineering environment What else do I need to know? Fluent command of English is a must No restrictions for travelling abroad temporarily. What We Offer? Speaking up Culture Respectful Workplace Being part of a global work environment Attractive remuneration package Excellent recognition tools providing spot awards Learning & Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth Leave days for parents and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family Creche allowance for mothers Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG Remote working and remote living flexibility only for relevant positions Find more benefits here Individual benefits are adapted to meet local legal regulations, the requirements of different job profiles, locations, and individual preferences. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. As Siemens we believe physical barriers are not related to potential. Only the potential matters to us. Therefore, we look forward to receiving applications from candidates with physical barriers and chronic illnesses. We support healthy relationships between candidates with barriers and their colleagues because we believe we can create differences together. Siemens is dedicated to quality, equality, and valuating diversity and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities within which we work. We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please ensure you complete all areas of the application form to the best of your ability as we will use the data to review your suitability for the role. Please find more information from our web site: https://new.siemens.com/tr/tr.html Explore our website to learn more about life at Siemens: https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/life-at-siemens/

title: Head of Development
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ downloads globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We’re looking for a Head of Development to lead our engineering organization and build AI-powered mobile products used by millions worldwide. You’ll work across Backend, Mobile, Frontend, and QA teams, driving technical strategy and execution from architecture decisions to product delivery. You’ll raise engineering standards, foster an AI-first development culture, and partner closely with leadership to scale both our technology and our team. What You’ll Do Define and drive the engineering strategy, architecture, and technology roadmap across our products. Lead engineering execution across Backend, Frontend, Mobile, and QA teams, from planning to delivery. Raise engineering standards through hands-on technical leadership, code reviews, and mentorship. Build scalable, secure, and high-performing systems while continuously improving reliability and developer productivity. Leverage AI-powered development tools and workflows to accelerate delivery and engineering excellence. Partner closely with Product, Data, AI, Marketing, and leadership to align technology with business goals. What We’re Looking For 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years in an engineering leadership role. Strong expertise in Node.js, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure). Practical experience with Flutter or native iOS/Android, with a solid understanding of the mobile development lifecycle. Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices, including AI-powered development tools, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Proven ability to lead engineering teams, make technical decisions, and deliver scalable, high-quality products. Strong communication skills, ownership mindset, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now, we're excited to meet you!

title: Senior Python Developer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Python Developer based in Turkey. Join an exciting remote development project focused on building a next-generation mobile application for a professional football team. As a Senior Python Developer, you will contribute to creating innovative digital experiences that strengthen fan engagement, enhance monetization opportunities, and connect supporters with the team both inside and outside the stadium. You will design and develop robust backend services, integrate AI-powered capabilities, and build scalable APIs to support seamless mobile interactions. Working with modern technologies and cloud infrastructure, you will help shape a high-performance, secure, and reliable platform. This role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on a digital product in the sports and technology space. You will collaborate with an international team in a remote-first environment, with occasional opportunities to meet in person. Accountabilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. Build and integrate RESTful APIs to support mobile application features, fan engagement functionalities, and digital service delivery. Implement AI-powered features by integrating services and models from providers such as OpenAI, Hugging Face, or similar platforms. Develop efficient asynchronous data flows and ensure reliable communication between application components and external services. Design, optimize, and maintain SQL and NoSQL databases to support performance, scalability, and data integrity. Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth2 and JWT, while following data privacy best practices. Containerize applications using Docker and support cloud deployment, preferably on Microsoft Azure. Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development, deployment automation, testing, and continuous improvement of development workflows. Collaborate with cross-functional team members to deliver reliable, user-focused solutions aligned with project objectives. Requirements Proven experience in Python development, ideally in building production-ready backend systems and scalable applications. Strong knowledge of FastAPI or Flask and experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs. Practical experience integrating AI and machine learning services through APIs, including OpenAI, Hugging Face, or comparable solutions. Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, JSON-based data exchange, and efficient data processing. Experience designing and working with relational and/or non-relational databases, including SQL and NoSQL technologies. Hands-on experience with Docker, cloud deployment, and CI/CD pipelines; familiarity with Microsoft Azure is a strong advantage. Good understanding of application security, authentication protocols, authorization, and data protection practices. Familiarity with Node.js is an advantage but not essential. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote team. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the flexibility to coordinate across working hours and contribute to an international development environment. Willingness to complete a HackerRank technical assessment as part of the recruitment process. Benefits Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from Slovenia, with occasional in-person team sessions, workshops, or gatherings expected approximately once per quarter, likely in Prague. Flexible working hours: Expected collaboration overlap is approximately 9:00–10:00 and 18:00–19:00 CET, with flexibility for a wider overlap appreciated. Innovative project: Contribute to a high-impact mobile application designed to transform the football fan experience through technology and AI. Modern technology stack: Work with Python, API integrations, AI/ML services, Docker, and cloud infrastructure. International collaboration: Work with a distributed team in a collaborative environment focused on delivering a sophisticated digital product. Expected start date: As soon as possible. Technical assessment: A HackerRank challenge is part of the selection process. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: (Pre-Sales) Technical Consultant (m/f/d) Turkey

With over 1,000 employees worldwide and customers in 140 countries, we enable the market — we never compete with it. Your team collaborates daily and continuously improves the status quo to achieve together the sales targets. Main Responsibilities Analyzing customer requirements and documenting requirements supporting the pre-sales process and successfully onboarding and training customers. Maintaining customer relationships while improving their processes. Developing and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, implementation guides, user manuals, and records of project activities and client interactions. Providing technical consultation on data architecture, integration, and management best practices, assisting in the design, development, and implementation of data solutions while promptly troubleshooting issues. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of proven experience as a Technical Consultant, Presales, project management, or product implementation (IT and software) or a similar role in the data industry. Strong knowledge of data technologies, databases, and data integration. Experience with data formats like XML, JSON and SQL. Programming language skills for Web Services (e. g. C#, Java, JavaScript, PHP). Business fluent in English and Turkish.
